headline: Sammaan Capital Limited: Timely Interest Payment on Listed Debentures
sum: Sammaan Capital Limited certified timely payment of interest on Secured Redeemable Non-Convertible Debentures (SRNCDT) issued via public issue and listed on stock exchanges. The intimation was filed under SEBI LODR Regulation 57, confirming compliance with debt servicing obligations.
detail: Sammaan Capital Limited, a non-banking financial company (NBFC), notified the NSE (and BSE) of timely interest payment on its Secured Redeemable Non-Convertible Debentures issued through public offering and listed on the stock exchanges. The certification was mandated under SEBI's Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements (LODR) Regulations, 2015, Regulation 57, which requires listed entities to immediately disclose any material events, including debt servicing updates. This is a routine compliance filing reflecting the company's adherence to its debenture payment schedule.
